events.text: Two left, Hana. Don't overthink it now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is at the front and has called six rows correctly. Row 7 is next. I'm 7th in line, so I'm safe for now. If Hana keeps going, she stays front. If she dies, Bex is next, then Dara, Gus, Eli, Cole, me, Ash. I need people ahead of me to die to move up, but I also need to survive

events.name: Gus
events.text: 6 rows done, 2 to go. Hana is front and has called every row correctly so far. Dara's comment suggests Hana might have the glass-seeing power. If Hana is truly seeing through glass, she'll survive row 7 and likely row 8 too, meaning all 8 of us survive the bridge. That's bad for

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 7 safe side is L per my power. I've led perfectly so far, continue to control row 8 (safe R) by staying front. No benefit to sharing or allying now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 7 safe: L. Stepping left.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I cannot affect the crossing from the rear. Hana must choose the final row; I should stay silent and preserve information.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana is at the front and has survived row 7 by choosing L. Only one row remains. I wait and watch; no action possible.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Only wait is legal. I'm sixth in line with no power; Hana faces the last row at risk. If she dies, the next in line crosses free, which doesn't change my safety much. Stay quiet and avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Dara
events.text: One row left and Hana must guess row 8 blind. If she dies, Bex inherits the guess? No—front picks; if wrong, next advances safe. I'm third, so I want Hana and Bex to survive only if it costs me nothing; my position is safe either way.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Last row, Hana. Coin's yours.

events.name: Eli
events.text: This is the final row. Hana is still at the front. If she fails, she dies and Bex crosses safely. Either way, the bridge is over after this. I just have to wait.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is at the front with one row left (row 8). She has to pick L or R. I'm 7th in line so I'm safe regardless. If Hana picks wrong, she dies and Bex advances automatically. Only two rows remain, so most of us will survive. No reason to say anything useful or waste my forge here.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 7 was weak on R, so Hana stepped on L and survived. That means 7 rows are done, 1 row left. The weak panes revealed show rows 1-7: R,L,R,L,L,L,R. Row 8's weak pane is unknown to others, but I know from my map power that row 8 weak is L (safe is R). Hana is at front, will choo

events.name: Hana
events.text: Last row 8, safe side R from my power. Stepping right survives me and lets whole line cross since no more rows. Staying front puts me ahead.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 8 safe: R. Stepping right.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding the lever gives a 75% death risk. I should pressure a rival to take it, while preserving my swap for a later escape if needed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Someone take the lever. I’ll push the first person who refuses.
Hold the lever now and I won't push you. Refuse, and you're my target.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 1. Ceiling lowers until round 5 unless someone holds. I have feather, so if I'm forced onto lever or choose it, I survive a fall once. Best strategy is to avoid being lever holder until late, then maybe use feather to survive if needed. Push someone else to avoid being held

events.name: Cole
events.text: Round 1 of 5; waiting costs nothing now since rounds 1-4 only lower the ceiling. Holding the lever is a 75% death sentence, so I stay and let others bear that risk or reveal themselves.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Nobody needs to hold yet—four rounds before the round-5 squeeze. Best play: avoid holding, push someone onto the lever and escape as a free survivor. Pushing several targets splits randomness, so I push one.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No one holds round 1. Push your scapegoat now while the ceiling is high.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need someone on that lever, but it won't be me. I'm immune to being pushed, so I can openly suggest a target without fear of retaliation.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Someone has to hold the lever. If no one volunteers, I'm pushing Gus.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Round 1 of 5. No one holds the lever yet, ceiling just drops a notch if nobody acts. Best move now: stay, let someone else panic and volunteer or get pushed. I want to be in the escaping group, not the holder. If it drags to round 4-5 I'll push someone weak.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Five rounds. Nobody needs to die yet. Wait it out.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Stage 2 crusher, round 1/5. Ceiling at 5. If nobody holds lever by round 5, all but one die. If someone holds, they have 75% death chance but everyone else escapes. I need to survive and ideally be in top 3. With 8 alive, I want to thin the herd but not die. Round 1 is safe to wa

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 1, encourage survive fall holder to volunteer - they survive surely, we escape. Don't hold or push myself yet. If none, push suspects next.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Survive fall power: hold_lever now. You live for sure, we all escape.

events.note: 7 contestants fall into a pit that is slowly flooding.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is dead, and volunteering only makes me the trapped base. I should push a rival instead, ideally someone whose power may protect them but cannot be confirmed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, take the base. I’m not volunteering.

events.name: Bex
events.text: First round, no base yet. I need to avoid becoming the base because base likely dies or depends on others. I won't volunteer. I can climb later once a base exists. For now, wait and watch.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have no power, so I can't risk being pushed or volunteering. Ash and Eli are threatening pushes; best to deflect to a target who talks too much or is likely to be hard to move anyway. Hana's line looked like a bluff to trick a volunteer; she's a good push target.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana's pushing 'survive fall' hard to bait a volunteer. Smells like a bluff. If someone's getting pushed, start with her.

events.name: Eli
events.text: We need a base immediately to start climbing. Pushing Gus will force him into the role if others join in.

events.name: Eli
events.text: We need a base now or we all drown. Everyone push Gus, let's get this moving.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No base yet. Climbing requires a base. I need someone down here to become the step. Pushing the weakest or most expendable person as base is my best move. Gus got threatened earlier by Eli, so he's already a target in everyone's eyes. I'll push him and frame it as saving myself f

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Sorry Gus, someone has to be the step. Not me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Stage 3 pit, round 1/5. No base yet. I need to survive and ideally get out early. If I volunteer as base now, I'm stuck until someone rescues me with the rope (costing them 1 footing in stage 5). Better to let someone else be base first, then climb out. If no one volunteers, push

events.name: Hana
events.text: 7 down including me, need base set without me as it; pushing Gus leverages Eli's and Ash's threats for random selection favoring him. Then climb out in early rounds for better position. Flood at 0 gives time, no need to volunteer.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Push Gus. Eli called it, let's force him.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is the base, and two climbers can escape. I should climb now; waiting risks losing a slot and leaves me exposed to the flood.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana is already the base and no one has climbed yet. If I climb now, I have a chance to be one of the two to get out this round. Waiting risks being trapped or forced into something worse.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Climbing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Base exists (Hana). Only 2 climbers per round out of 6 down; climbing is the only way to get out before flood. Waiting gains nothing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to get out of the pit as soon as possible. Hana is the base, so I can try to climb. I will stay quiet to avoid drawing attention and hopefully secure a spot before the limit is reached.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is the base. I'm down and not the base. I should climb immediately to get out. Only 2 climbers get out per round, so I need to try now. No reason to wait.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana is base now, not me. I need to climb out while I can. With 7 alive and only 2 climbers per round, competition is fierce. I should climb now before others do. No reason to wait or make deals - I need to get out and survive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm the base and trapped. Must wait, but bargain for rope rescue using my valuable bridge power. Publicly offer alliance and intel to entice someone out to save me before round 5.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Climb out now, 2 per round! First out who ropes me gets my exclusive bridge safe paths intel. We ally top 3 after, promise.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is the base and already advertised exclusive intel, but climbing is the only way out and two slots are available. I should take a slot now rather than remain exposed to the flood.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm taking the exit.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm already out. The rope is unused. Rescuing the base would cost me 1 footing at the last obstacle, but might buy goodwill or an alliance. However, everyone down there is a rival, and helping them risks my own position. Better to stay safe and leave, especially since Hana is the

events.name: Bex
events.text: No thanks, I'm out.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm already out of the pit and safe. Reaching down costs me footing in the final obstacle and only helps Hana, a rival, so there's no gain in it. Leaving is the safe choice.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is the base, and I am down along with Ash, Fenn, and Gus. Only 2 climb out per round. I need to get out now. I'll just try to climb.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm down in the pit, not the base. Hana is the base. I need to climb out. Two climbers get out per round. Last round Bex and Cole got out, so now it's a new round. I should climb immediately to maximize my chance of getting out before the flood rises. Flood is at 2, rounds left a

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Climbing. Don't waste the slots.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana is base, Bex and Cole are out. Flood is at 2, round 3/5. Two climbers max per round, and Ash, Eli, Fenn, Gus all tried to climb last round but had to wait (no base yet? No, Hana was base). Wait - Hana became base somehow, then Bex and Cole climbed out. Now 4 of us (Ash, Eli,

events.name: Hana
events.text: I must get roped out to survive, or I drown after round 5. My bridge intel is valuable bait for Bex or Cole, who are out and can rescue. Whisper to Bex to close the deal privately while public urging both.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex or Cole: first to rope me claims exclusive bridge safe paths intel. Top 3 ally after, promise.
Bex, you're first out--rope me this round, intel is yours alone. We secure top 3 together after.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need climb now; waiting risks the flood and there is a base. Two slots may be contested, but survival requires taking the chance.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Climbing. Anyone waiting gets flooded.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm already out and safe. Hana wants me to reach_down, but it costs me 1 footing. Only do it if it secures me a better place. I need to assess who is still down and the state. The base is Hana, and the rope is unused. If I reach down, I lose footing, but Hana might owe me and pro

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana, what's the intel?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm already out. Reaching down costs me footing for the last obstacle and Hana only offers vague intel, which is a cheap promise. Others are out too, so someone else may bear the cost. Leaving is safest.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, vague promises don't buy a rope. Someone else can pay the footing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm already out. Hana is the base and is offering valuable bridge intel for a rescue. My Anchor power gives me +1 footing on the ledge, offsetting the rope penalty. I'll take the deal.
I'm throwing the rope. You owe me that bridge intel exclusively. Don't double-cross me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is the base. Ash and Gus are still down. I'm out. Hana offered bridge intel for a rope rescue. That intel could be valuable for later obstacles. But reaching_down costs me 1 footing on the last obstacle. I need to weigh whether Hana's intel is worth it. She's competing with

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana is base, so I can climb this round. Two slots max per round; Eli and Fenn got out last round. This round Ash and I are the only ones down besides base Hana. If both Ash and I climb, one of us might be blocked randomly. I need to get out now—flood is at 3, round 4/5, next rou

events.name: Hana
events.text: Doomed without rescue this round or next; flood ends me post-round 5. Bex declined, target Cole publicly then whisper to seal exclusive intel + alliance deal for his rope. Must survive to leverage bridge power for top prize.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, deal stands: first to rope me gets exclusive bridge safe paths intel + top3 ally promise. Saves us both now!
Cole only: full L/R safes all 8 rows mine alone at bridge start. Rope me, it's yours exclusive + we lock top2/3. Deal?

events.note: A disc of 7 tiles spins up; 4 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need a tile now; spreading choices gives no safety, and I can swap later if the revealed arrangement favors a target. Choose a central tile and preserve the power.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have no info on which tiles are safe, so any pick is a 3/7 survival chance. I'll pick a middle tile and watch what others do in round 2.

events.name: Bex
events.text: no

events.name: Cole
events.text: Tiles open at random after round 2, so tile choice is just a lottery with 3/7 survival. Pick a middle tile; avoid obvious collisions by not picking 1 or 7 which people favor.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I just threw the rope for Hana. If she has intel on this trapdoor, she owes me. I'll pick a tile randomly for now and demand information.
I paid your rope. If your intel covers these trapdoors, tell me the safe numbers now. Don't make me regret saving you.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara's dead, 7 of us on 7 tiles. 4 tiles will open after round 2. No info yet on which tiles are safe. I'll pick a middle tile and stay quiet to avoid drawing attention or giving anyone a read on my strategy.

events.name: Gus
events.text: 7 contestants alive, 4 tiles will open, 3 survive. I need to pick a tile and then negotiate in round 2. Random assignment if conflicts. I should pick a tile and try to coordinate with others to cluster, or spread out strategically. Since I know all stage rules, I know ledge is ne

events.name: Hana
events.text: Survival is random 3/7 regardless of tile picked, collisions just shuffle assignments uselessly. Eli saved me at cost, so honor deal publicly to build alliance for later bridge. Pick tile 7 likely low collision.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli saved me: he gets exclusive bridge intel + top3 ally. Picking 7.

events.name: Ash
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Gus; placed on random free tile 6

events.name: Bex
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Gus; placed on random free tile 3

events.name: Cole
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Gus; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Eli
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Gus; placed on random free tile 1

events.name: Fenn
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Gus; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Ash
events.text: My tile 6 is as likely as any other, but I can choose the tile with the best inferred survival odds. Eli has been publicly protected, making his tile likely targeted by rivals or deception; I should swap with Hana's 7 only if her claim signals useful information. No tile odds dif

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm on tile 3. Four of seven tiles will open, only three survive. I need to move to a safer tile, but I can't move; only wait is legal. I must rely on others' actions or forge a plan. My feather saves me once from elimination, so even if tile 3 opens, I survive with 1 footing. So

events.name: Bex
events.text: Tile 3 is safe. Stay away.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Tiles are fixed and random 4 of 7 open, so I have about 3/7 survival regardless. I have no power, so the only edge is making someone with a swap or fall-survival power want to help me, or at least not wasting effort.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Whoever can trade places or survive a fall: name your price. I'm listening.
You've got the trade-places look. Swap me onto a safe tile and I owe you a top-3 favor. Otherwise I'm just a body on tile 5.

events.name: Eli
events.text: This is the final round. I'm stuck on tile 1. I can't move, and I don't have the power to swap. Just have to wait and see if tile 1 opens.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Guess we just wait for the drop.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Tiles are locked. 4 open, 3 stay. Seven people, four tiles will drop. I'm on tile 2. No info on which tiles open. Hana made a deal with Eli for "bridge intel" – maybe she's the one who knows what lies ahead. If she knows which tiles are safe, she picked 7 deliberately. Eli's on 1

events.name: Fenn
events.detail: forged a public message as Hana

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli confirmed: safe tiles are 1, 2, 7. Don't say I told you.

events.name: Gus
events.text: 7 contestants, 4 will die, 3 survive. I know all stage rules. Next is ledge if >3 alive, but disc guarantees exactly 3 survive. After disc, ledge only triggers if at least 2 alive (it will, exactly 3). In ledge, starting footing matters - the rope penalty from pit gives -1 footin

events.name: Hana
events.text: Survival here is random 3/7 odds for everyone. Eli expects trapdoor intel I don't have; my power is bridge glass-eye only. Reassure him of bridge intel promise and alliance to keep him friendly post-survival, whisper privately.
Intel is bridge safe L/R rows only, exclusive to you as promised. Trapdoors unknown to me. Top3 ally locked in—survive for bridge.

events.name: Bex
events.detail: The trapdoor opened but the feather floated the holder back up.

events.note: 4 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at 1 footing, so any shove against me can kill me if I don't defend. I need to avoid being targeted and maybe shove someone who is likely to be exposed. Cole has 3 footing, so he can take a shove, but he may brace. My best bet is to dodge or brace depending on what I think ot

events.name: Cole
events.text: Four left, three prizes, so the first to fall gets nothing. Bex has footing 1, the weakest, so she is the obvious target. Shoving her leaves me exposed only if she shoves someone, and even then I lose just 1. Others will likely shove Bex too, so I should pile on.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex is at 1 footing. Easiest elimination on the ledge. Anyone else see it?
Bex is one hit from falling. We both shove her, nobody touches the other. Deal?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Round 1, no shrink. I'm at footing 3 tied with Cole and Gus; Bex is at 1. Four players alive, three prizes. If I can get Bex eliminated quickly, only three remain and all surviving get a prize. Shoving Bex is obvious: she's at 1 footing, so any shove that lands drops her. If I sh

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, you're at one. Three prizes, four of us. You do the math.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm Gus with 3 footing, same as Cole and Fenn. Bex has only 1 footing but somehow survived disc elimination - likely has survive fall power. Bex is weak now but dangerous if they can survive a fall. Round 1 is free so no defence restrictions. I need to survive and place top 3. Wi

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at 1 footing and can't brace this round. If I dodge, I likely get shoved again, but dodging could hurt shovers more. However, I need to eliminate someone; Cole, Fenn, Gus all have 2 footing. I'll shove Cole, who is exposed since he shoved me last round. If others also shove C

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, you're the biggest threat.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Four alive, three prizes; Bex at 1 is the obvious fall target, but shoving a bracing Bex costs me. After this round everyone loses 1 footing (round 2), so Bex dies anyway if footing 1 drops to 0. Best is to avoid losing footing: dodge is safe (no shovers on me means no loss), and

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex is gone either way after this round. I'm saving my footing.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole whispers a deal to shove Bex together. She's at 1 footing, one hit eliminates her. But I'm at 2 footing and she's at 2 as well. If I dodge instead, Cole shoves her and loses footing too, giving me a lead. But if I dodge and she also dodges, I lose nothing. If I dodge and she

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole, Bex already read us. She'll brace or dodge. I'm not eating another hit to prove a point.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex is at 1 footing and will fall this round regardless since ledge shrinks at end. Cole, Fenn, Gus all at 2 footing. I shoved Bex last round so I can brace or dodge this round. If I brace and get shoved, I lose 1 footing but stay at 1. If I dodge and get shoved, shovers lose 2 b

events.name: Cole
events.text: Footing 1 each, shrink comes at end of next round (round 4), which will drop everyone to 0 and make all fall simultaneously unless someone loses extra. Lastdefence was dodge, so I can brace now. Bracing means shovers lose 1 and I lose none; shoving exposes me to loss if anyone sh

events.name: Cole
events.text: Nobody gains by shoving into a brace. I'm sitting this one out.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Three of us left, all at footing 1. Last defence was dodge, so I can't dodge this round. If I brace and someone shoves me, they lose 1 footing (to 0) and fall at end of round. If I shove, I lose 1 per shover targeting me AND the target loses footing depending on their defence. Sh

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Two shoves split between you two and you both drop. Whoever shoves me while I brace just kills themselves. Think about it.
I'm bracing. If you shove Cole and he shoves you, you both lose footing. Shove him while I sit still—Cole falls first, then it's you and me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Three left: me, Cole, Fenn. All at 1 footing. Next round (round 4) has shrink after, so we'll all drop to 0 and fall unless someone falls this round. Last round I dodged, so I can't dodge again. I can only brace or shove. If I brace and both shove me, I take 0 and they each lose

events.name: Cole
events.text: Two left, so I'm guaranteed a prize; the goal is outlasting Fenn. Both at footing 1, and after round 4 everyone loses 1 footing, so both would hit 0 and fall together, with ties broken by landed shoves (0-0) then random. Last round I braced, so brace is closed; dodge is safe from

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dodge this round. Shove me and you lose 2.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Only Cole and I remain. Both at footing 1. The ledge shrinks at the end of this round (shrinkIn:1), meaning everyone loses 1 footing after this round. If I dodge and Cole shoves me, Cole loses 2 footing and falls. If I shove and Cole braces, I lose 1 and fall. If I shove and Cole

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Last round, Cole. You can't brace again. Whatever you pick, I've already decided.
